`class BorderShaderPass`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IShaderPass`](/reference/shaders/ishaderpass/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.pipeline.pass` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BorderShaderPass.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/pipeline/pass/BorderShaderPass.java)

Outlines the shape of the previous result with a colored stroke that follows its alpha, rounded corners included.

## Description

The stroke follows the edge of what was drawn, so it wraps a rounded or circular shape drawn by an earlier pass.

## Learn more

- [Shaders](/use/learn/going-further/shaders/)

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [corners](#BorderShaderPass-property-corners) | `boolean` | `true` | If `true`, the stroke also covers the outer corners of the area; if `false`, the corner zones, where the stroke goes past the area in x and in y at once, keep the previous result unchanged. |
| [mode](#BorderShaderPass-property-mode) | [`BorderMode`](/reference/shaders/bordershader-bordermode/) | `BorderMode.OUT` | Where the stroke sits: [`BorderShader.BorderMode.OUT`](/reference/shaders/bordershader-bordermode/#BorderShader-BorderMode-value-OUT) outside the edge of the shape, [`BorderShader.BorderMode.IN`](/reference/shaders/bordershader-bordermode/#BorderShader-BorderMode-value-IN) inside it. |

## Property details

<a id="BorderShaderPass-property-corners"></a>

### corners

- `this corners(boolean corners)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Default:** `true`

If `true`, the stroke also covers the outer corners of the area; if `false`, the corner zones, where the stroke goes past the area in x and in y at once, keep the previous result unchanged.

<a id="BorderShaderPass-property-mode"></a>

### mode

- `this mode(BorderMode mode)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Default:** `BorderMode.OUT`

Where the stroke sits: [`BorderShader.BorderMode.OUT`](/reference/shaders/bordershader-bordermode/#BorderShader-BorderMode-value-OUT) outside the edge of the shape, [`BorderShader.BorderMode.IN`](/reference/shaders/bordershader-bordermode/#BorderShader-BorderMode-value-IN) inside it.
